name: Jet carving
summary: The cutting and polishing of jet, a hard black fossil wood, into beads, brooches and cameos.
how: Cut the rough jet to a block with a saw.
Carve the block with a knife and a file into the form of the piece.
Polish the piece with fine powder until it shines black.

origin.note: Whitby workshops begin to turn local jet into beads and ornaments.

adoptions.via: After the death of Prince Albert, jet jewels become the dress of court mourning, and the Whitby trade grows.
